four_key_questions.Q1_novelty_beyond_speedysplat_flashgs_ac: NONE. TFC mode1 == AccuTile ellipse-exact tile set; strict subset (tfc_only=0); O(rows)>=O(min(rows,cols)); omits isY. FlashGS per-tile edge test, QuadBox, StopThePop all cover ellipse-tile overlap.
four_key_questions.Q2_expensive_work_eliminated_by_novel_de: NONE. TFC eliminates ~0 additional intersection work beyond AccuTile (B2). The only measured real remaining compute after AccuTile is ORTHOGONAL to footprint: backward block-level atomic accumulation (~65% of backward, 7.5x warp duplication, conservative E2E 5-12%, additive with AccuTile; R6-A), forward staging floor / per-tile AABB reject (LAW-AABB-TILE TS32 1.63-1.85x), per-pixel transmittance early-stop (gsplat built-in 1-2%). None of these is TFC.
four_key_questions.Q3_gradient_difference_requires_further_: YES_CHARACTERIZE_NOT_REPAIR. A-vs-B gradient diff is REAL (PBR0 train cam151 aa_cos 0.9999522864818573 vs ab_cos 0.9993930160999298) and ACCUMULATES over 30K (TFC_FC0 garden dPSNR -0.0717 dB > 0.05 dB gate). Mechanism: tile membership computed on DETACHED tensors => discrete tile routing not differentiated => changed gradient routing/aggregation. This is INHERENT to ANY footprint culling (AccuTile B1A 30K garden also -0.714 dB); it is not a TFC-specific bug. No new TFC-specific correction is warranted; if any footprint method is adopted the perturbation must be reported as a known quality trade, and the blanket 'only atomic noise' explanation is DISALLOWED (PBR0/TFC_FC0 show real accumulation).
four_key_questions.Q4_tfc_fc0_complete_and_tierA_metric: YES_COMPLETE_BUT_VS_WEAK_BASELINE. TFC_FC0 is a real, complete 30K run: room/garden/bicycle, seed42, gsplat v1.5.3 EPIC-05 A100-SXM4, torch 2.10. TIER-A metric: TFC_FC0_TIMING speedup_30k geomean 1.0594x (room 1.0467, garden 1.0679, bicycle 1.0639) = AABB-baseline wall-clock ratio. Quality gate FAIL (garden dPSNR -0.0717 dB) => fail-closed. NOT a claim vs AccuTile; different cohort than AccuTile 30K (1.1039x).
